Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger

output.surprise: Wannan abin mamaki ne! Barayin sun sace Liman da wasu 10 a lokacin sallar Asuba a Neja suna nema a lale musu Miliyoyi!
output.disgust: Wannan ya yi zafi! Barayin sun yi amfani da sallar Asuba a Neja don sace Liman da wasu 10 suna neman a lale musu Miliyoyi, abin da ya sa kowa jin jiya ta!
